Description: Disperses all fog in a 10'/lvl R
Cuts all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) by 30 mph in a 10'R (will not affect breathing)
Creates a 5'R near vacuum; anyone within the radius must make a successful RR or take a 'B' Impact critical as the air leaves and rushes back in
Caster can remove the oxygen in a 10'R at the rate of 1% of the original oxygen each round
As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 20'
As Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'
Changes any gas to normal air at a rate of 1cubic per round as long as the caster concentrates
As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 100'
As Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 20'
As Vacuum I, except delivers a 'D' Impact critical
As Deoxygenation I, except removal rate is 5% per round
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 50'
As Great Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'
As Mass Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'
As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removeal rate is 10% per round
As Vacuum I, except delivers an 'E' Impact critical
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removal rate is 20% per round
As Major Vacuum, except affects a 10'R

Destroys gases in a single enclosure (e.g., usually a building) up to a size of 100'x100'x100' (or 1,000,000 cu'). The building has a chance of collapsing (dependent on construction) and everyone inside takes an 'E' Impact critical from falling debris. This results in a very loud explosion. If the building collapses, everyone within 100' of the building takes a 'C' Impact critical from the explosion. SPECIAL NOTES 1) All vacuums created by spells on this list also create a loud noise. The larger the radius, the louder the noise. The GM may wish to rule that all within the radius must make a second RR or be deafened for 1 round per 10 failure (RR attack level equals the radius of the vacuum). 2) An elemental creature made of gas will be cut to 20% activity if it is the target of an Air Stop spell (and the creature fits into the area of effect). A Vacuum spell thrown upon an elemental creature made of gas will result in a Slaying critical on the creature. 3) When the oxygen in an area of effect falls below 50% of normal, anyone in the area of effect must make a RR (attack level is 1) or fall asleep (this RR is modified by -2 for every 1% under 50%). Of course, if the % drops below 10%, suffocation becomes a danger. All fire spells in an area of low oxygen are modified by -2 (or -2 % effectiveness for non-attack spells) for every 1% under 50% of normal oxygen. SORCERER BASE LIST 3.7.3 GAS DESTRUCTION
